نسرندي (form IIIq)
# نَسْرَنْدِي (nasrandī) /nas.ran.diː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْرَنْدَى (israndā)
# نَسْرَنْدِيَ (nasrandiya) /nas.ran.di.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْرَنْدَى (israndā)
